about_the_game:
The Boulder Becomes the Hero

In Rock and Scroll you follow Sisyphus who is now cursed to be the very boulder he pushed up the mountain, as he tries to outwit the gods one last time in this literal side scroller platform game.

Scroll to Move, Click to Jump—Simple? Think Again.

Unlike other platforms, you scroll to move and click to jump. Sounds easy, right? Well, if you're using a trackpad, good luck—you're basically doomed.

Experience a level of frustration you never knew existed as you attempt to scroll with perfect timing and speed as you jump through history.

Master the Madness, Beat the Clock, Brag to Mum

Master the art of scrolling as you fumble your way through history, desperately trying to time each jump just right. Difficulty modes range from Easy - with training wheels like quick save and a jump indicator - to iron man where you'll only have one life throughout the whole game. Oh, and there's a floor is lava mode, so have fun with that.

For those who've truly mastered the movement, there's a built-in speed run timer, perfect for proving to your parents that all those hours weren’t a complete waste. Who knows? Maybe they will even put it on the fridge.

Collectibles, Time Travel, and Questionable Helpfulness

With precise platforming mechanics, momentum-based movement, and cool collectibles, you'll need to uncover secrets hidden deep within each level to help our rock get through time.

Along the way, you'll roll into some famous figures from history each with their own absurdly specific problems. Complete their challenges to uncover secrets, alter history (probably for the worse), and prove that even as a rock, you're more helpful than most people.

New Eras, New Rules, Same Pain

Each level introduces a new mechanic designed either to ruin your day. One moment you're dealing with inverted scroll controls, the next you're stuck in a time period where gravity changes direction at random, each era brings its own flavour of torment. Just when you think you’ve mastered the controls, the game finds a new way to mess with you.
